audit_record.terminal_message: Initialized a center-fed dipole antenna for the 915 MHz ISM band (0.915 GHz). The design features copper cylindrical arms of length 76.18 mm each with a 1.09 mm wire radius, separated by a 3.28 mm feed gap (total length 155.63 mm) and excited via a 50-ohm discrete port. Geometric and excitation checks passed with no warnings.
